annotations.title: Kto gra w Twoim mieście i kiedy / Concerts in Poland

description: Kto gra w moim mieście w ten weekend? Gdzie i kiedy zagra mój wykonawca? Nadchodzące koncerty w Polsce z KiedyKoncert.pl po wykonawcy (literówki są tolerowane), miejscowości z promieniem, datach i gatunku. / Who is playing in my city this weekend, and when does my artist play? Upcoming concerts in Poland listed on KiedyKoncert.pl. Filters: artist, band, festival or show name (typos tolerated); Polish locality with radius; dates or a `when` shortcut; genre. Returns up to 20 concerts per call (page further with offset/next_offset): date, time, city, venue, price from, status incl. cancelled and the concert page link, plus the total number of matches and browse_url with the full list. Default range: next 60 days; with `artist` and no dates: all announced dates.

artist.description: Artist, band, festival or show name, e.g. "Dawid Kwiatkowski". / Wykonawca, zespół lub nazwa wydarzenia.

city.description: Polish city, town or village in nominative case, e.g. "Kraków"; for a village name used in many places add the municipality, e.g. "Nowa Wieś, gm. Bircza". / Miejscowość w Polsce.

genre.description: Genre slug or Polish name, e.g. rap, rock, pop, jazz, metal, classical, electronic, disco-polo (see list_genres). / Gatunek.

offset.description: Skip this many matches (paging); use next_offset from the previous result. / Przesunięcie listy.

radius_km.description: Search radius around the city in km (10-100, default 30).

when.description: Date shortcut computed in Europe/Warsaw; this_weekend = Friday-Sunday. Overrides date_from/date_to.

name: search_concerts

browse_url.description: KiedyKoncert.pl page with the full list.

value.description: Pass this value as `city` to pick this locality.

distance_km.description: Distance from the searched locality; null = in the locality itself.

other_times.description: Further shows of the same event that day.

price_label.description: Price in Polish, e.g. "od 99 zł", or a note such as "Sprawdź cenę u sprzedawcy".

time.description: HH:MM; start time if known (see time_kind).

time_kind.description: start = stage time; doors_only = only doors opening is known; source_unspecified = the source gives one time without saying if it is doors or start.

url.description: Concert page on kiedykoncert.pl (ticket links and full details are there).

interpreted_as.description: Name used after correcting a typo.

next_offset.description: Present when more matches exist: pass as offset to get the next page.

note.description: Guidance for answering, e.g. when nothing was found.

search_hint.description: Where to look on KiedyKoncert.pl when nothing matched.
